# bioAffinity Technologies to Present New Perspectives on CyPath® Lung’s Use for Cancer Risk Assessment at CHEST 2026


October 15, 2026 8:00am EDT


***Chief Medical Officer Gordon Downie, MD, to host CHEST 2026 Learning Theater on clinical use of CyPath® Lung***


***Presentation to address current challenges in pulmonary nodule management and to discuss preliminary research data from the ongoing development of a new, investigational test for asthma and COPD***


***bioAffinity Technologies' Medical and Scientific Advisory Board to convene in conjunction with CHEST 2026***


SAN ANTONIO, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[bioAffinity Technologies, Inc.](http://www.bioaffinitytech.com/) **(Nasdaq: BIAF; BIAFW)** , **** a biotechnology company developing noninvasive healthcare solutions for the early detection and monitoring of lung disease, will sponsor a Learning Theater presentation at[CHEST 2026](https://www.chestnet.org/learning-and-events/events/chest-annual-meeting?&utm_medium=ppc&utm_source=google&utm_campaign=annual-meeting&gad_source=1) , the annual meeting of the American College of Chest Physicians, on the evolving role of[CyPath® Lung](http://www.cypathlung.com/) in improving lung cancer risk stratification and managing pulmonary nodules in patients at high risk for lung cancer. The presentation will include discussion of the Company’s positive research data in the development of its new test measuring asthma and COPD-related lung inflammation and drug-related receptors.


bioAffinity Technologies Chief Medical Officer Gordon H. Downie, MD, PhD, will address the challenges clinicians face as the growing number of newly discovered and changing pulmonary nodules increases the difficulty of determining which nodules require intervention and which can be safely monitored. Using clinical cases, the presentation will examine the limitations of predictive models and the potential role of the lung microenvironment in improving lung cancer risk stratification.


"With increased lung cancer screening rates, more incidental findings and AI's ability to mine medical records, we are getting better at finding pulmonary nodules. But that is just the first step," Dr. Downie said. "By analyzing cells from the lung microenvironment, CyPath Lung's binary result – either likely or unlikely malignancy – provides new information that complements imaging, clinical risk models and physician gestalt to help inform decisions about further testing, biopsy or continued surveillance."


CyPath Lung is a noninvasive sputum-based test that uses flow cytometry and an automated analysis pipeline developed using AI to evaluate cellular characteristics associated with lung cancer. By analyzing cells collected directly from the lungs, the test provides important information distinct from imaging and blood-based biomarkers. The noninvasive CyPath Lung test can be used on high-risk individuals without an identified nodule and in patients with a prior cancer diagnosis. The Company's test for asthma and COPD-related lung inflammation referenced below is an investigational research program and is not available for clinical use.


**CHEST 2026 Learning Theater**


**Title:** *Lung Nodules, Lung Microenvironment, Predictive Models and Clinician Risk Stratification: Using CyPath® Lung Testing for Early Diagnosis of Lung Cancer* **Date:** October 21, 2026
**Time:** 12:30-1:15 p.m. MST
**Location:** Learning Theater 4, Phoenix Convention Center, Phoenix, AZ


**bioAffinity Technologies Medical and Scientific Advisory Board to convene at CHEST 2026**


In conjunction with the conference, bioAffinity’s[Medical and Scientific Advisory Board](https://bioaffinitytech.com/science/#board) will meet to discuss the Company’s scientific and clinical programs, including CyPath Lung's expansion into the federal healthcare system, the ongoing large-scale, longitudinal clinical study for CyPath Lung, and research and development to characterize lung inflammation in asthma and COPD patients, which may lead to targeted therapies and precision medicine.


"Our Medical and Scientific Advisory Board’s extensive experience in real-world pulmonary practice and lung health is directly aligned with our corporate and clinical mission to improve outcomes for patients by detecting lung cancer and other lung diseases early when treatment is most effective," said Maria Zannes, bioAffinity Technologies President and CEO. "We are always grateful for their expert perspectives that inform our research priorities and clinical applications."


Current members of the Medical and Scientific Advisory Board are David Hill, MD, Chair of the American Lung Association Board of Directors; David Ost, MD, MPH, Department of Pulmonology, University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center; Daniel Sterman, MD, Director of Division of Pulmonary, Critical Care, and Sleep Medicine, New York University Langone Medical Center, Sheila Habib, MD, Director of the Pulmonary Lung Nodule Clinic and the Lung Cancer Screening Program at South Texas Veterans Health Care Systems, Audie L. Murphy Memorial Veterans Hospital; J. Scott Ferguson, MD, Director of Bronchoscopy, University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health; Neil Alexis, PhD, Principal Investigator at the University of North Carolina School of Medicine Center for Environmental Medicine, Asthma and Lung Biology; and Sandeep Bansal, MD, Medical Director of Lung Innovations Network.


**About CyPath Lung**


CyPath Lung by bioAffinity Technologies is a noninvasive test designed to improve the early detection of lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease. CyPath Lung uses advanced flow cytometry and proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) to identify cell populations in patient sputum that indicate malignancy. CyPath Lung incorporates a novel fluorescent porphyrin that is preferentially taken up by cancer and cancer-related cells. In a[published clinical trial](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12931-023-02327-3) of high-risk patients, CyPath Lung demonstrated 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 88% accuracy and 99% negative predictive value (NPV) in detecting lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease who had small indeterminate lung nodules less than 20 millimeters. The high NPV may help inform physician decision-making when evaluating whether further invasive procedures are warranted. CyPath Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT), is not intended for use as a sole diagnostic tool, and should be considered alongside other clinical findings. For more information, visit[www.cypathlung.com](https://www.cypathlung.com/) .


**About bioAffinity Technologies, Inc.**


bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. addresses the need for noninvasive diagnosis of early-stage cancer and other diseases of the lung and broad-spectrum cancer treatments. The Company’s first product, CyPath Lung, is a noninvasive test that has shown high sensitivity, specificity and accuracy for the detection of early-stage lung cancer. CyPath Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) by Precision Pathology Laboratory Services, a subsidiary of bioAffinity Technologies. LDTs are overseen under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), which are administered by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. For more information, visit[www.bioaffinitytech.com](http://www.bioaffinitytech.com/) .
